scientific.integrity: The proof combines the source's fixed-pattern dimension converse and correlated-erasure feedback formula with explicit short binary codes whose coordinate projections attain every sectorwise bound. Exhaustive finite projection checks are corroborative only.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is specific to qubit inputs, average success probability, and blocklengths at most three; the minimality conclusion uses the primary source's strict four-use result and does not determine the exact four-use no-feedback optimum or address maximum-error equality without feedback.

title: Four transmissions are the first possible feedback advantage for the qubit erasure channel
